physics_findings: The open-chain hard-core Hamiltonian and initial three-site occupation uniquely define isolated dynamics. Its density evolution equals the supplied free-fermion density for every stated control; replacing the bosonic off-site one-body observable by the fermion matrix is a physical observable substitution, not an eigensolver or normalization bug.

For the augmented occupied-orbital construction, determinant overlaps give <b_i b_j^dagger>. Transposition off diagonal and 1-G_ii on the diagonal give <b_i^dagger b_j>, consistent with the independent 56-state fixed-particle-number reference.

The sudden interaction-off, lattice-off release preserves the pre-release state and makes far-field imaging measure bosonic one-body coherence. The independently removed orbital envelope, phase convention and per-site average 3/8 determine the reported normalization.

With rho_ij=<b_i^dagger b_j> and v_j=exp(-i*q*x_j), v^dagger rho v/8 has the specified Fourier sign. The reference independently applies creation and annihilation in the occupation basis without Jordan-Wigner determinant machinery.

Both closures preserve density, particle number, positive momentum profiles, initial incoherent momentum and nearest-neighbor correlations. The source is a complete valid fermion Gaussian construction whose interpretation as bosonic long-range coherence is wrong.
